:::{#sol-tensor-entries-practice}

An entry of $\mathcal{B}$ is picked by choosing $i_1$ from $10$ values,
$i_2$ and $i_3$ from $32$ values each,
and $i_4$ from $3$ values,
so the number of entries is

$$
\ba
n_1 \cd n_2 \cd n_3 \cd n_4
&= 10 \cd 32 \cd 32 \cd 3
&& \text{(substitute the index ranges)}
\\
&= 30720.
&& \text{(multiply)}
\ea
$$

:::
